title: carex scabrida
intro: Carex scabrida, commonly known as the hairy sedge, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is a perennial sedge that grows in wetlands and is native to various parts of the world, including North America, Europe, and Asia. The health benefits of Carex scabrida include its potential to help reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
